section.content: 本发明提供了一种锂离子电池，包括第一导电连接部、第二导电连接部和若干极芯，极芯包括正极和负极，所有极芯的正极和负极均卷绕于第一导电连接部的外侧，第一导电连接部和第二导电连接部中的其中一个用于连接并固定若干正极，第一导电连接部和第二导电连接部中的另一个用于连接并固定若干负极。通过第一导电连接部和第二导电连接部分别连接和固定极芯的正极和极芯的负极，而提高了极芯与极芯间连接的稳定性，提高锂离子电池整体的结构稳定性，避免了电解液浸润困难、电池性能较差、循环性能差的缺陷，提高了锂离子电池的浸润效果，从而保障了锂离子电池的循环性能。本发明还提供一种包括锂离子电池的锂离子电池组。

The invention provides a lithium ion battery which comprises a first conductive connecting part, a second conductive connecting part and a plurality of pole cores, wherein each pole core comprises a positive pole and a negative pole, the positive poles and the negative poles of all the pole cores are wound on the outer side of the first conductive connecting part, one of the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part is used for connecting and fixing the plurality of positive poles, and the other of the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part is used for connecting and fixing the plurality of negative poles. The first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part are respectively connected with and fix the anode of the pole core and the cathode of the pole core, so that the stability of connection between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the structural stability of the whole lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are avoided, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is ensured. The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack comprising the lithium ion battery.

Lithium ion battery and lithium ion battery packTechnical Field

The invention relates to the field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack.

Background

With the development of the new energy automobile industry, the lithium ion power battery becomes a mainstream energy storage structure of the new energy automobile, the requirements on the energy density and the integration degree of the battery pack are higher and higher, and the long-size lithium ion battery gradually becomes one of mainstream development directions of the lithium ion battery due to the advantages of high energy density and high integration degree of the battery pack.

Cylindrical batteries are much lower than pouch or aluminum-can batteries at the same capacity size because of their simple fabrication equipment and inexpensive structural component costs. However, the conventional cylindrical battery generally has a low capacity, and for a 100kwh power battery used by an electric vehicle, thousands of battery cells need to be connected in series and parallel. Too many series-parallel connections impose severe requirements on the reliability of the battery and the consistency of the battery cells.

In the prior art, the capacity of a battery cell is improved by increasing the size or length of a cylindrical battery. However, most of the schemes simply lengthen the pole pieces, do not optimize the battery structure, and have difficulty in soaking the electrolyte, which results in poor battery performance, especially poor cycle performance, and unstable overall structure of the battery.

Chinese patent publication No. CN 211480207U discloses a long battery cell group, a long battery, a battery module and a power battery, wherein the long battery cell group includes a battery cell group stacked by more than one battery single-stage group, a protection frame is arranged around the battery cell group, the protection frame includes end plates respectively arranged on both sides of the length direction of the battery cell group and side plates on both sides of the width direction, the end plates and the side plates are sequentially connected end to end, a hole is arranged on the side plates, and a tab of the battery single-stage group passes through the hole. This patent is through setting up the effect of protective frame around electric core utmost point group thereby playing the protection group battery. However, the added protection frame not only occupies the volume of the battery core, so that the volume of the battery case needs to be correspondingly increased, the cost and the weight of the battery are increased, but also the soaking effect of the battery is affected by the arranged protection frame.

Therefore, it is necessary to provide a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack to solve the above problems in the prior art.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack, which aim to solve the problems of unstable battery structure, difficult electrolyte infiltration and poor battery cycle performance caused by overlong length of the conventional pole core.

In order to achieve the above object, the lithium ion battery of the present invention includes a first conductive connecting portion, a second conductive connecting portion and a plurality of pole cores, wherein the first conductive connecting portion is disposed on an inner side of the pole core, and the second conductive connecting portion is disposed on an outer side of the pole core;

the pole core comprises a positive pole and a negative pole, the positive pole and the negative pole of the pole core are wound on the outer side of the first conductive connecting part, one of the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part is used for connecting and fixing the positive poles, and the other of the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part is used for connecting and fixing the negative poles.

The lithium ion battery has the beneficial effects that:

according to the lithium ion battery, the first conductive connecting part is arranged on the inner side of the pole core, the second conductive connecting part is arranged on the outer side of the pole core, and the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part are reasonable in arrangement position and small in occupied size; the positive pole of the pole core and the negative pole of the pole core are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part, so that the connection stability between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are overcome, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is guaranteed.

Optionally, the pole piece is cylindrical in shape.

Optionally, the first conductive connection portions are cylindrical in shape, and the number of the first conductive connection portions is 1;

the inner side surface of the second conductive connecting part is in close contact with the outer side surface of the pole core.

Optionally, the lithium ion battery further includes a first tab pad and a second tab pad, one end of each of the pole cores is provided with the first tab pad, and the other end of each of the pole cores is provided with the second tab pad.

Optionally, the second tab pad includes a first pad and a second pad, the front cross section of the first pad is in an "Contraband" shape structure, and the front cross section of the second pad is in an "i" shape structure; the first bonding pad is arranged at one end, away from the direction of the adjacent pole core, of the pole core at the edge, and the second bonding pad is arranged between the two adjacent pole cores.

Optionally, the first tab pad is sleeved outside the first conductive connection portion, the first pad is fixed and connected to the second conductive connection portion on the outer side of the pole core at the edge, and the second pad is fixed and connected to the second conductive connection portion on the outer side of the two adjacent pole cores.

Optionally, one end of the first tab pad is connected to the positive electrode through a positive tab to fixedly connect the positive electrode and the first conductive connection portion. The positive pole and the first conductive connecting part are connected through the first pole lug bonding pad, so that the positive poles of the pole cores are fixed, and the parallel connection of the positive poles of the pole cores is realized.

Optionally, the end face, facing the pole core, of the first pad is connected to the negative electrode of the pole core through a negative electrode tab, and the two ends of the second pad are respectively connected to the negative electrodes of the two adjacent pole cores through negative electrode tabs so as to fixedly connect the negative electrodes to the second conductive connection portion. The negative pole and the second conductive connecting part are connected through the first bonding pad and the second bonding pad, so that the negative poles of the pole cores are fixed, and the parallel connection of the negative poles of the pole cores is realized.

Optionally, one end of the first tab pad is connected to the negative electrode through a negative tab to fixedly connect the negative electrode and the first conductive connection portion. The negative pole and the first conductive connecting part are connected through the first tab bonding pad, so that the negative poles of the pole cores are fixed, and the parallel connection of the negative poles of the pole cores is realized.

Optionally, the end face of the first pad facing the pole core is connected to the positive pole of the pole core through a positive tab, and the two ends of the second pad are respectively connected to the positive poles of the two adjacent pole cores through the positive tabs so as to fixedly connect the positive pole and the second conductive connecting portion. The positive pole and the second conductive connecting part are connected through the first bonding pad and the second bonding pad, so that the positive poles of the pole cores are fixed, and the parallel connection of the positive poles of the pole cores is realized.

Optionally, the lithium ion battery further includes an insulating assembly, and the insulating assembly is disposed between the second conductive connection portion and the first tab pad and between the first tab pad and the second pad. The conductive connection structure has the beneficial effects that the first lug bonding pad is prevented from being electrically conducted with the second bonding pad and the first lug bonding pad is prevented from being electrically conducted with the second conductive connection part, and the short circuit caused by the conduction of the anode and the cathode is avoided.

Optionally, the lithium ion battery further includes a housing, a first cover plate, and a second cover plate, where the housing is disposed outside the second conductive connecting portion, and a first opening and a second opening are respectively disposed on two opposite end surfaces of the housing; the first cover plate is arranged at the first opening, a positive pole is arranged on the first cover plate, and the positive pole is connected with the positive pole; the second cover plate is arranged at the second opening, a negative pole column is arranged on the second cover plate, and the negative pole column is connected with the negative pole.

The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack which comprises at least two lithium ion batteries, wherein the at least two lithium ion batteries are connected in series or in parallel.

The lithium ion battery pack has the beneficial effects that:

the positive pole of the pole core and the negative pole of the pole core are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part, so that the connection stability between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are overcome, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is ensured.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention clearer, the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are a part of the embodiments of the present invention, but not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention. Unless defined otherwise, technical or scientific terms used herein shall have the ordinary meaning as understood by one of ordinary skill in the art to which this invention belongs. As used herein, the word "comprising" and similar words are intended to mean that the element or item listed before the word covers the element or item listed after the word and its equivalents, but does not exclude other elements or items.

In view of the problems in the prior art, an embodiment of the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, and fig. 1 is a cross-sectional view of a lithium ion battery according to a first embodiment of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1, the lithium ion battery of the present invention includes a first conductive connection portion 1, a second conductive connection portion 2, and a plurality of pole cores 3, wherein the first conductive connection portion 1 is disposed on an inner side of the pole core 3, and the second conductive connection portion 2 is disposed on an outer side of the pole core 3;

the pole core 3 comprises a positive pole 31 and a negative pole 30, the positive pole 31 and the negative pole 30 of all the pole cores 3 are wound outside the first conductive connecting part 1, and the positive pole 31 and the negative pole 30 on each pole core 3 are separated by a diaphragm (not shown in the figure).

One of the first conductive connecting part 1 and the second conductive connecting part 2 is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of anodes 31, and the other of the first conductive connecting part 1 and the second conductive connecting part 2 is used for connecting and fixing a plurality of cathodes 30.

The lithium ion battery has the advantages that: according to the lithium ion battery, the first conductive connecting part 1 is arranged on the inner side of the pole core 3, the second conductive connecting part 2 is arranged on the outer side of the pole core 3, and the first conductive connecting part 1 and the second conductive connecting part 2 are reasonable in arrangement position and small in occupied size; the positive electrode 31 of the pole core 3 and the negative electrode 30 of the pole core 3 are respectively connected and fixed through the first conductive connecting part 1 and the second conductive connecting part 2, so that the stability of connection between the pole core 3 and the pole core 3 is improved, the overall structural stability of the lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are overcome, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is guaranteed.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, the pole core 3 is in a cylindrical shape, and the end portions of two adjacent pole cores 3 are connected to each other, specifically, two adjacent pole cores 3 are connected in parallel, that is, two positive electrodes 31 of two adjacent pole cores 3 are connected in parallel, and two negative electrodes 30 of two adjacent pole cores 3 are connected in parallel.

In some embodiments, the pole piece 3 has a shape of any one of a cylinder, a rectangular cylinder, and a long bar.

Fig. 2 is a schematic cross-sectional structural diagram of an end portion of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1 and 2, the first conductive connection portions 1 are cylindrical, the number of the first conductive connection portions 1 is 1, the first conductive connection portions 1 are inserted into the axial centers of all the pole cores 3 of the lithium ion battery, and the first conductive connection portions 1 are used for connecting and fixing the positive electrodes 31 or the negative electrodes 30 of all the pole cores 3;

each pole core 3 is correspondingly connected with at least one second conductive connecting part 2, the inner side surface of the second conductive connecting part 2 is in close contact with the outer side surface of the pole core 3, specifically, the shape of the inner side surface of the second conductive connecting part 2 is consistent with the shape of the outer side surface of the pole core 3 at the position where the pole core 3 is in contact with, for example, when the outer side surface of the pole core 3 is an arc surface, the inner side surface of the second conductive connecting part 2 is also an arc surface, and the second conductive connecting part 2 is used for fixing an anode 31 or a cathode 30 positioned at the outer side of the pole core 3, so that the overall packaging volume of the lithium ion battery is saved.

It can be supplemented that a gap or a groove can be provided between the second conductive connecting portion 2 and the pole core 3 as required, for example, a plurality of second conductive connecting portions 2 are provided at intervals outside each pole core 3, referring to fig. 2, each pole core 3 is correspondingly connected with two second conductive connecting portions 2, and a gap 22 is formed between two adjacent second conductive connecting portions 2 on the same pole core 3; or a groove 21 is formed in the inner side surface or the side part of the second conductive connecting part 2, so that an electrolyte channel is formed between the second conductive connecting part 2 and the pole core 3, the infiltration efficiency of electrolyte is improved, and the electrolyte infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved.

In some embodiments, referring to fig. 2, the shape of the pole piece 3 is identical to that of the first conductive connection part 1, and is any one of a cylindrical shape, a rectangular cylindrical shape, and a long strip shape; the first conductive connecting part 1 is located at the axis of the pole core 3, and the first conductive connecting part 1 is coaxial with the pole core 3.

Fig. 3 is a schematic front cross-sectional structure view of a first tab pad according to an embodiment of the present invention, and fig. 4 is a schematic end-face cross-sectional structure view of the first tab pad and a first conductive connection portion according to an embodiment of the present invention.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, the lithium ion battery described with reference to fig. 1, 3 and 4 further includes a first tab pad 4 and a second tab pad 5, and the first tab pad 4 is disposed at one end of each of the pole cores 3.

Fig. 5 is a schematic front cross-sectional structure diagram of a first bonding pad according to an embodiment of the present invention, fig. 6 is a schematic front cross-sectional structure diagram of a second bonding pad according to an embodiment of the present invention, and fig. 7 is a schematic end cross-sectional structure diagram of a second ear bonding pad and a first conductive connection portion according to an embodiment of the present invention.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 5 to 7, the second tab pad 5 includes a first pad 51 and a second pad 52, the first pad 51 has an "Contraband" shape in front section, and the second pad 52 has an "i" shape; the second bonding pad 52 is connected between the connecting ends of two adjacent pole cores 3, and the first bonding pad 51 is disposed at one end of the edge of the pole core 3 far from the direction of the adjacent pole core.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1, the first tab pad 4 is sleeved outside the first conductive connection portion 1, an inner side surface of the first pad 51 is fixed and connected to the second conductive connection portion 2 outside the core 3 at the edge, and an inner side surface of the second pad 52 is fixed and connected to the second conductive connection portion 2 outside two adjacent cores. Two adjacent second conductive connection portions 2 are fixed by the second pads 52 to function as conductive connection and fixation.

It can be said that, referring to fig. 4 and 7, the first tab pad 4, the first pad 51 and the second pad 52 are annular in overall shape in side view, and the first tab pad 4, the first pad 51 and the second pad 52 each have a through hole 40 therein for allowing the first conductive connection portion 1 to pass through.

In some embodiments, referring to fig. 1, a notch portion 20 is disposed at an end of the second conductive connection portion 2, and a shape of the notch portion 20 is consistent with a shape of a side portion of the second pad 52 and a side portion of the first pad 51, so that the side portions of the second pad 52 and the first pad 51 are conveniently embedded into the notch portion 20, so that outer side surfaces of the first pad 51 and the second pad 52 do not protrude out of an outer surface of the second conductive connection portion 2, flatness of a surface of the fixed pole core 3 is ensured, and a volume occupied by a lithium ion battery is also saved.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1, the lithium ion battery further includes a housing 6, a first cover plate 61, and a second cover plate 62, wherein the housing 6 is disposed outside the second conductive connecting portion 2, and two opposite end surfaces of the housing 6 are respectively provided with a first opening and a second opening; the first cover plate 61 is arranged at the first opening, a positive pole 312 is arranged on the first cover plate 61, and the positive pole 312 is connected with the positive electrode 31; the second cover plate 62 is disposed at the second opening, a negative pole 302 is disposed on the second cover plate 62, and the negative pole 302 is connected to the negative electrode 30.

In some possible embodiments of the present invention, referring to fig. 1, in the first embodiment of the lithium ion battery of the present invention, one end of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the positive electrode 31 through the positive tab 311 to fixedly connect the positive electrode 31 and the first conductive connection portion 1, so as to fix the positive electrode 31 of the pole core 3 and realize parallel connection of the positive electrodes 31 of the plurality of pole cores 3;

the first bonding pad 51 faces the end face of the pole piece and is connected with the negative electrode 30 of the pole piece 3 through the negative electrode lug 301, and two ends of the second bonding pad 52 are respectively connected with two adjacent negative electrodes 30 of the pole piece through the negative electrode lug 301 so as to be fixedly connected with the negative electrode 30 and the second conductive connecting part 2, so that the fixation of the negative electrodes 30 of the pole piece is realized, and the parallel connection of the negative electrodes 30 of the pole piece is realized.

In some embodiments, the first conductive connection part 1 and the second conductive connection part 2 are made of conductive materials, and preferably, the first conductive connection part 1 connected to the positive electrode 31 is made of aluminum material, and the second conductive connection part 2 connected to the negative electrode 30 is made of graphite material.

In some embodiments, the end of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the positive tab 311 by welding, the inner side of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the first conductive connection portion 1 by welding, and one end of the first conductive connection portion 1 is connected to the positive post 312 by welding, so that the positive electrode 31, the positive tab 311, the first tab pad 4, the first conductive connection portion 1 and the positive post 312 are electrically connected and fixed;

two ends of the second bonding pad 52 are respectively connected with the negative electrode tabs 301 of two adjacent pole cores 3 in a welding manner, and the inner side of each second bonding pad 52 is connected with two adjacent second conductive connecting parts 2 in a welding manner;

one end of the first pad 51 is connected with the negative electrode tab 301 of the pole core 3 at the leftmost end in a welding manner, the inner side of the first pad 51 is connected with the second conductive connection part 2 at the outer side of the pole core 3 at the leftmost end in a welding manner, one end of the first pad 51 is connected with the negative pole column 302 in a welding manner, and fixation and electrical connection of the negative electrode 30, the negative electrode tab 301, the first pad 51, the second pad 52, the second conductive connection part 2 and the negative pole column 302 are realized.

Fig. 8 is a cross-sectional view of a lithium ion battery in a second embodiment of the invention.

In some possible embodiments of the present invention, referring to fig. 8, the lithium ion battery in the second embodiment shown in fig. 8 is different from the lithium ion battery in the first embodiment shown in fig. 1 in that: one end of the first tab pad 4 in the second embodiment shown in fig. 8 is connected to the negative electrode 30 through a negative tab 301 to fixedly connect the negative electrode 30 and the first conductive connecting part 1, so as to fix the negative electrodes 30 of the pole cores 3 and to connect the negative electrodes 30 of a plurality of pole cores 3 in parallel;

the first bonding pad 51 faces the end face of the pole core 3 and is connected with the anode 31 of the pole core 3 through the anode lug 311, two ends of the second bonding pad 52 are respectively connected with two adjacent anodes 31 of the pole core 3 through the anode lugs 311 so as to be fixedly connected with the anode 31 and the second conductive connecting part 2, the anode 31 of the pole core 3 is fixed, and the parallel connection of the anodes 31 of the pole cores 3 is realized.

In some embodiments, the first conductive connection part 1 connected to the negative electrode 30 is made of a graphite material, and the second conductive connection part 2 connected to the positive electrode 31 is made of an aluminum foil material.

In some embodiments, the end of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the negative tab 301 by welding, the inner side of the first tab pad 4 is connected to the first conductive connection portion 1 by welding, and the first conductive connection portion 1 is connected to the negative post 302 by welding, so that the negative electrode 30, the negative tab 301, the first tab pad 4, the first conductive connection portion 1 and the negative post 302 are electrically connected and fixed;

two ends of each second bonding pad 52 are connected with the positive lugs 311 of two adjacent pole cores 3 in a welding mode, and the inner side surface of each second bonding pad 52 is connected with two adjacent second conductive connecting parts 2 in a welding mode;

the end part of the first pad 51 is connected with the pole core 3 at the leftmost end through a welding mode to form the positive lug 311, the inner side of the first pad 51 is connected with the second conductive connecting part 2 at the outer side of the pole core 3 at the leftmost end through a welding mode, one end of the first pad 51 is connected with the positive post 312 through a welding mode, and the positive pole 31, the positive lug 311, the first pad 51, the second pad 52, the second conductive connecting part 2 and the positive post 312 are fixed and electrically connected.

As an alternative embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 1 and 8, the lithium ion battery further includes an insulating assembly 7, and the insulating assembly 7 is disposed between the second conductive connection portion 2 and the first tab pad 4 and between the first tab pad 4 and the second pad 52. This is advantageous in that electrical conduction between the first tab pad 4 and the second pad 52 and between the first tab pad 4 and the second conductive connecting portion 2 is prevented, and short circuit caused by conduction between the positive electrode 31 and the negative electrode 30 is prevented.

In some embodiments, the insulating member 7 has a structure of 'Contraband' in a front cross-section, and the insulating member 7 is surrounded on the outside of the first tab pad 4, thereby preventing the second conductive connecting part 2 and the second pad 52 from being electrically connected to the first tab pad 4 and preventing the short circuit of the battery. The insulation of the structure is realized through one structure, so that the cost and the volume are saved, and the weight of the battery is saved.

In some embodiments, the constituent material of the insulating assembly 7 comprises plastic.

The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack which comprises at least two lithium ion batteries, wherein the at least two lithium ion batteries are connected in series or in parallel.

The lithium ion battery pack has the advantages that: the first conductive connecting part and the second conductive connecting part are respectively connected with and fix the anode of the pole core and the cathode of the pole core, so that the stability of connection between the pole core and the pole core is improved, the structural stability of the whole lithium ion battery is improved, the defects of difficult electrolyte infiltration, poor battery performance and poor cycle performance are avoided, the infiltration effect of the lithium ion battery is improved, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is ensured.

Although the embodiments of the present invention have been described in detail hereinabove, it is apparent to those skilled in the art that various modifications and variations can be made to these embodiments. However, it is to be understood that such modifications and variations are within the scope and spirit of the present invention as set forth in the following claims. Moreover, the invention as described herein is capable of other embodiments and of being practiced or of being carried out in various ways.
